page_title: CRY 5-0 AST | Crystal Palace v Aston Villa 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) commits a rough foul. Darren Bond stops the game and makes a call.
90+2' Clement Lenglet (Aston Villa) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Eberechi Eze did his best and is replaced by Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace).
88' James Tomkins (Crystal Palace) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Joachim Andersen.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jairo Riedewald (Crystal Palace) will replace Adam Wharton.
87' Unai Emery decides to make a substitution. John McGinn will be replaced by Finley Munroe (Aston Villa).
87' A substitution has been made. Moussa Diaby is replaced by Kaine Kesler Hayden (Aston Villa).
86' Crystal Palace fail to score from a corner as Robin Olsen (Aston Villa) leaps to collect the ball.

85' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Robin Olsen thwarts him with a great two-handed save. It will be a corner kick for Crystal Palace.
82' A sweet pass inside the box gives Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
78' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
76' Marc Guehi goes off the pitch and Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) comes on.
76' Oliver Glasner has decided to make a change. Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) replaces Jean-Philippe Mateta.
76' The attendance for today's match is 25191.
73' What was Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
69' 5 - 0 Goal! Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
68' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tim Iroegbunam (Aston Villa) replacing Calum Chambers.
68' The referee signals a substitution. Omari Kellyman (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for Ollie Watkins.
67' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Crystal Palace due to an offside in the build-up play.
67' The Crystal Palace players halt their celebrations as referee Darren Bond makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

66' GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 4:0.
63' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

63' 4 - 0 Goal! Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) takes a short pass from Eberechi Eze in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 4:0.
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Crystal Palace.
61' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
58' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
57' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
54' 3 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom left corner.
53' Referee Darren Bond sees the trip by Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
52' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) unleashes a decent strike, but it goes just over the bar. What a chance!
47' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) gets inside the box and tries to beat Robin Olsen with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
43' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) sends an accurate short pass. Adam Wharton controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
42' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
39' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Daniel Munoz tees up Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) inside the box and he curls the ball into the top left corner and past Robin Olsen.

38' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Robin Olsen easily catches the ball.
36' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
34' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
33' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:2.
31' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar.
30' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
29' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
27' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) tackles a bit over-zealously and Darren Bond blows for a foul.
25' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) plays a lovely through ball to Jean-Philippe Mateta, but he can't beat Robin Olsen and loses the ball.
24' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
21' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
19' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
18' John McGinn (Aston Villa) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
18' Aston Villa earn a corner.
18' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
17' The Aston Villa players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
16' Aston Villa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
14' The linesman raises his flag. Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is adjudged offside.
12' Darren Bond sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
11' Wait! Referee Darren Bond has indicated he is going to review the Crystal Palace goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

9' 1 - 0 Goal! Michael Olise produces a great pass that finds Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
6' Aston Villa will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
6' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
4' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Aston Villa will have the kick-off.
Darren Bond was nominated as the referee for this game.
